jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a) inventory: Barre Unified Union School District, a unified union district that is its own supervisory district (member municipalities Barre City and Barre Town).
Barre Unified Union School District (official district website).

sources.note: Barre Unified Union School District amended Articles of Agreement (voter-approved February 19, 2019): 'The Board of School Directors shall have nine (9) members, with four (4) residing in and representing Barre City; and four (4) residing in and representing Barre Town; and one (1) elected at-large by the voters of both municipalities.' The eight town seats are elected by that municipality's voters only; terms are three years, staggered. (The State Board's original November 2018 default articles, still hosted by the AOE, set a four-member board and are superseded.)

Barre Unified Union School District, 'Our Board of Directors' (official, live): the nine current directors with their seats and term ends; the same nine are listed as present, none absent, in the board's March 9, 2026 and September 8, 2026 regular-meeting minutes.

Michael Boutin chaired the Barre Unified board as a Barre City director into February 2026 (the district's April 16, 2025 press release names him Chair; he chaired the February 12, 2026 meeting). He is absent from the March 9, 2026 reorganization minutes and the current board page, and appears as a public attendee in the April 6, 2026 minutes -- his membership is ended in 2026; whether he lost or did not seek re-election is not stated in the fetched sources.
